book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Yeisu I Patileid Apostol-yan Si He-yawate Si He-iwo Si Setagi

Yeisu i gonid wana topadavae-yan si he-yawate si he-iwo (12) si lok heine, ge i giyau gaisi heidiye iloke bosowaidiye yayaluwo bikbikine si patile tagtaganid ge si pamoluid bobode henebwaden hedi gide ge hedi bole tomase ge tomase.
Apostol-yan si he-yawate si he-iwo hidadiye ti ya: dedei, Saimon, gane hidane si hune Pita, ge havane Andru; Jems Sebedi natune, ge havane Jon;
Filip ge Batolomiu; Tomas ge Metiu gane takis hana tohowo; Jems Alfiyes natune ge Tadiyes;
Saimon gane i hudi boda Selot heidiye, ge Judas Iskariyot, iye i waseyan Yeisu.

Yeisu i epatileid apostol si he-yawate si he-iwo hebwaden ya si setagi, iyete i gopagaisiid i nga, “Tab hu elok henebwaden taine Isrel bobodeidiye sohode he wedi ganahao, o hebe hu esetuk Sameriya he habadiye.
Age hu lok ege boda Isrel hana sip haohaoidiye heidiye.
Hu la hu papalapu hu nga, ‘Helak wana bagalogugui hana sauge hobak i sepasepase.’
Hu pamoluid tobolebole, hu pasuwoyukid tomate, hu bagavetaheid toraupoga, ge yayaluwo bikbikine hu patile tagtaganid. Hobak hu howo tan maisane, hu giyau tab maisane.
Tab mwani gold, silba o kopa hu edohe he lemi pwaus ge hu elosehowo;

tab kaliko hana nabo hu elosehowo lemi dodogan kaiwane, tab kaliko mwamwalao ho-iwoine, o hehemiu hana pase o hepotihe hu eseho. Tab hu enunuwotu, kaiwane tokaiwo hedi logugui te matahasikidiye bwele i gan.
Sauge hebe hu setuk he hiyebe hotiya o he yawan hotiya, tolomo dodohobine hotiya hu luweni he tei, bwen hu miye he wana guwole hana had hu yogo.
Sauge hu setuk he guwole, hu liwo heidiye hu nga, ‘Helak i giyau mimalum heimiu.’
Hebe bobode hebwaden he guwole tei si yariyae kaiwamiu, lemi gomulolu mimalum kaiwane i misuwok heidiye. Hebe taine, humiu ege hu paidi mimalum, age sidiye taine.
Hebe taine si deyariyae kaiwamiu ge taine lemi lihulihu si delonge, bwen guwole tei o hebe hiyebe tei hu seyok ge hehemiu puhauine hu tagakakalan yok.
Tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, he hasehase hana yan Sodom ge Gomora hedi pepelase i puyowo, age hiyebe yake hedi pepelase bwele i puyowo suwok.
Todumuyai Bwele Si Hamnohon Tilao
A patilemiu sohode sip si ela hehewo mamalekeidiye he gamwadiye. Hu sibe sohode mwate ge hu senapu sohode lumlum.
Hu yehemiu, kaiwane bobode papaine bwele si yomoteimiu he kot ge siyo veveroroine bwele si howo ge si rabikmiu he wedi guwole tapwalolo.
Hidau kaiwane bwele si howomiu ge si yomoteimiu tologugui ge kin he matadiye, iloke hu waseyan wase dodohobine heidiye ge henebwaden taine Judiya-yan sohode heidiye.
Sauge hebe si howomiu hu la kot kaiwane, tab hu enunuwotu sahe bwele hu elihuyan o hebe mwatan bwele hu gopagan. He sauge yake heto lihulihu hu elaman bwele Helak i giyau heimiu.
Taine tage humiu hu delihulihu, age Tamamiu Yayaluwane i miye heimiu iye te i lihulihu.

Bobode bwele si waseyanid he-hauhavadiye iloke tologugui si lopamateid. Tame bwele si ginawi sohode hedi he-nanatudiye heidiye. Bubuyese bwele si midi he-tintinadiye ge he-tamtamadiye si hata mamaliye-yanid, iloke si giyau tologugui si lopamateid.
He hidau kaiwane bobode hohoyowate bwele si hata mamaliye-yanmiu, age sega hebe i midi gaigaisi hana had he bagapamwao bwele i mwad.

Sauge hebe si patilaomiu he yawan hotiya bwen hu iwowo hu la yawan hotiya hedi. Tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, lemi kaiwo taine bwele hu depamwao Isrel wedi yawan bwabwaligane heidiye bwen Tolomo Natune i luwom.
Tosikuru taine i dekai lake wana topapalapu; tokaiwo taine i dekai lake wana guyau. Nau tilao a paidi, iyete humiu hedi bwele tilao hu paidi.

I dohob ege te tosikuru sohode wana topapalapu, ge tokaiwo sohode wana guyau. Nau guwole tonuwage, si nga tage nau Toberenunu, iyete humiu lo guwole hana tomiye, bwele ide ngakngakidiye suwok habe si tin heimiu.
Tab Ta Ematokanid wada Pan Bobode
Tab hu ematokanid bobode, kaiwane bigi yayabomidiye bwele si mwapwe ge bigi mumusumoidiye bwele si youmate.
Heto sahe gane a lihuyan heimiu he gogou, hu lihu-yan he wayae; heto sahe gane a hawasige-yan he batimiu, hu la he guwole pwatane hu gon yaleyale-yan.
Tab hu ematokanid hebwaden si tagapamate tutuwo age taine bosowaidiye yayaluwo si detagapamate. Helak ege te hu matokan, iye bosowaine tutuwo ge yayaluwo i bagapangakid he hel.
Ripripuye ho-iwo si paliyan toya hotiya, age? Agegene taine hotiya i desopiyele he kelekele tage Tamamiu taine i delapu.
Sohode hedi humiu hulumiu pupululune bwabwaligane hobak i pahone mwao ge i lapu vetahemiu.
Iyete tab hu ematok. Humiu hotiya ge hotiya hu kai lake ripripuye hohoyowate maisadiye.
Sega bobode he matadiye i gopayoumate tage iye lo tolomo, nau hedi bwele a gopayoumate sohode ti yo Tamau heine he bulubulu.
Agegene sega bobode he matadiye i yahakanau, nau hedi bwele a yahakan Tamau heine he bulubulu.
Yeisu kaiwane Bobode Si Hata Mamaliye-yanide
Tab hu enunuwotu a luwom ge tage mimalum a ho luwom he panayawi. A luwom taine tage mimalum a deho luwom, agegene maleke.
A luwom a tagaeneene bobode wedi miyemiye. Tolomo i hata mamaliye-yan tamane, vaini i hata mamaliye-yan tinane, ge tolomo poniyene i hata mamaliye-yan yawanine.
Tolomo hana siviye bwele si hudi he-tutuine he gamwadiye.

Sega hebe i nunuwane-yanid vetahe tamane ge tinane agegene nau taine i denunuwane vetahe-yanau, taine bosowaine ta denga, ‘Iye lo todumuyai.’ Sega hebe i nunuwane-yan vetahe natune tolomoine o hebe vainiine agegene nau taine i denunuwane vetahe-yanau, taine bosowaine ta denga, ‘Iye lo todumuyai.’
Sega hebe taine i dehiyewo wana koros ge i dedumuyau heyau, taine bosowaine ta denga, ‘Iye lo todumuyai.’
Sega yawedine i paidi, bwele i supwahao, ge sega hebe yawedine i supwahao nau kaiwau, bwele yawedine i paidi.
Hebe Ta Labeid Helak wana Tokaiwo
Sega hebe i pagopasemiu, i pagopaseyau, ge sega i pagopaseyau, i pagopase gane i patileyau.

Sega hebe i pagopase Helak wana hepapatile kaiwane iye Helak wana hepapatile, bwele maisane i howo sohode Helak wana hepapatile maisane; sega hebe i pagopase tolomo dodohobine kaiwane iye tolomo dodohobine, bwele maisane i ho sohode tolomo dodohobine maisane.
Sega hebe i hudu bwai tuituiine ge i giyau hebwaden tankaikai ya hotiya heine kaiwane iye lo topadavae, tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, maisane taine i dekwale bwele i howo.”
